scope.ordering: Rotating syntax arm order within each unit, every round; fresh Node process per cell. No simultaneous builds/tests/timings on this machine. Machine load recorded per sample; reject run if load1 >10.
scope.timings: Child parse, validation, C compilation with optimization true, plus whole-process wall time. Same frozen frontend/backend bytes for each arm. Process peak RSS includes module/source loading and output hashing. No model inference or native C compiler time in this stage.
scope.scope: Private flat-v2 parameter-use optimization, same grammar as the frozen study-v2 parser;1582exact differential observations pass. Common public validator/optimizer/backends for all arms. No public/A0-native cutover or final grammar claim.
scope.correction: All arms use exactly the same authoritative public checker, optimizer and backend instances. Only parsing differs. This removes the private-checker cache-identity difference from the provisional original run, which remains preserved.
scope.change: Accumulate inferred parameter count during operand parsing instead of rescanning all function operands after parsing. All prior slow-parser results remain retained.

limitations: Research harness, same public checker/optimizer/backend across arms; not a completed single-source frontend.
Peak RSS includes common preloaded research modules and input/output accounting, not just the compiler.
No inferred runtime speedup from byte-identical emitted artifacts. Losses and earlier measurements are retained.
